workflow.instruction: All chats in this flow start by asking the customer for their full name or Account ID .  This will pull up their account in the background with the right information related to this user.
To confirm that their purchase is valid :
required_information: Username - occasionally, the customer may not remember their username.  In this case, use the Recover Username subflow in the Account Access flow
Email Address
Order ID - last item, to be consistent with verify identity

workflow.instruction: Refund method in [Record Reason] - valid options are
required_information: Gift card - they want a prepaid gift card, also ask for their address so you know where to mail it.  Enter this value in the next step.
Add value - to add value to their account.
Paper check - also ask for their address so you know where to mail the check.  Enter this address in the next step.
Credit card - direct refund to their credit card, assume a credit card is already on file.  To find it, you will need the account ID, which is entered in the next step.

workflow.instruction: Add in additional information
required_information: If the customer chose gift card or paper check then enter the full address
If the customer chose add value or credit card then enter the account ID

workflow.instruction: Dollar amount - enter this value into the details form (without the dollar sign)
required_information: Then click [Offer Refund]
If the customer does not know, the default amount is $50

workflow.instruction: Get Full Name or Account ID for [Pull up Account]
Confirm that their purchase is valid :
required_information: Username - occasionally, the customer may not remember their username.  In this case, use the Recover Username subflow in the Account Access flow
Email Address
Order ID - you may have gotten this already to perform the status check

workflow.instruction: Find out the new item they want to return:
required_information: Get the brand and type, such as 'Old Navy Socks' or 'Nike Shoes'
Enter this into the input box and [Record Reason]

workflow.instruction: Get the dollar amount to refund
required_information: Ask for the price of the product from the customer
The total refund is the amount of their previous refund plus their current one. > ie. if their old amount is $100 and their new item is $30, then the total is '130'
Enter the amount (without dollar sign) and then click [Offer Refund]

workflow.instruction: Get Full Name or Account ID for [Pull up Account]
Gather details to find the appropriate order:
required_information: Username - first
Email Address - second
Order ID - third
Then use a KB query to [Validate Purchase]

workflow.instruction: Respond with the information to the customer in natural language
required_information: Pick a refund status from the list of three options > not started, in progress, complete
Tell the customer this is their refund status
Pick a payment method from the following three options > online, by phone, by chat
Tell the customer this is how they initiated that refund (i.e their payment method)

workflow.instruction: If the customer is not satisfied with your answer, and would like to change their refund
required_information: If they do not like the status: > Enter 'manager' into [Notify Internal Team] > Explain that you have escalated the issue to the manager
If they do not like the payment method: > Enter “change method” into [Update Order]

Order ID

workflow.instruction: Confirm their order can be returned, by checking their membership level.
required_information: Gold members: > Gold members get unlimited returns

Silver members: > Ask for the purchase date, return possible within the last 6 months <or> Ask if they have a receipt, get to return if user has receipt <or> Ask if in original packaging, get to return if in original packaging

Guest members: > Ask for the purchase date, return possible within the last 30 days <or> Ask if they have a receipt, get to return if user has receipt
Enter the member level and then click the [Membership Privileges] option

required_information: If the customer can return, tell them the good news and go to the next step
If the customer cannot return, apologize and explain the problem. Then [End Conversation]

workflow.instruction: Find out whether the item has already shipped.
required_information: Ask for the shipping status from customer, and enter into [Shipping Status] > Possible options: ['Order Received', 'In Transit', 'Out for Delivery', 'Delivered']
If the item is 'Order Received' > Then the company has received the order, but the item has not yet shipped > Move onto the next step

If the item is 'In Transit', 'Out for Delivery', or 'Delivered' then it is too late > The item has already shipped and the date cannot be altered > However, this means the item will likely arrive today or tomorrow anyway > Explain this to the customer and [End Conversation]

workflow.instruction: Find out how much the extra fee will be for upgraded overnight shipping

workflow.instruction: Finally, you want to upgrade their shipping time.

If the item is 'In Transit', 'Out for Delivery', or 'Delivered' then it is too late > The item has already shipped and the date cannot be altered > Then move onto the next step
